FREELANCE SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT
Governed by the laws of India
This Freelance Software Development Agreement (the "Agreement") is made at Pune on 1 October 2026 (the
"Effective Date") between Orion Retail Private Limited, a company incorporated under the Companies Act,
2013, having its registered office at Baner, Pune, Maharashtra 411045 (the "Client"), and Rahul Deshmukh,
an individual professional residing at Dharampeth, Nagpur, Maharashtra 440010 (the "Freelancer"). The
Client and the Freelancer are together called the "Parties".
1. Scope of Services
The Freelancer shall design, develop and test a mobile shopping application for Android and iOS for the
Client (the "Project"), including a product catalogue, shopping cart, UPI payment integration and order
tracking. The Freelancer shall deliver the Project within 16 weeks from the Effective Date.
2. Fees and Payment
The total fee is Rs. 1,20,000 (Rupees One Lakh Twenty Thousand only), payable as 30% on signing, 40% on
delivery of the beta version and 30% on final acceptance. Each invoice shall be paid within 60 days of receipt.
The fee is exclusive of Goods and Services Tax, which shall be charged if applicable under the Central
Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017. The Client may deduct tax at source as required under the income-tax
law in force and shall provide the deduction certificate. No interest shall be payable on delayed payments.
3. Term and Termination
This Agreement continues until the Project is accepted. The Client may terminate this Agreement at any time
by giving 7 days' written notice, and shall then pay only for work it has accepted. The Freelancer may
terminate only by giving 60 days' written notice.
4. Intellectual Property
On receipt of full payment, the Freelancer assigns to the Client, under Section 19 of the Copyright Act, 1957,
the entire copyright in the deliverables for the whole world and for the full term of copyright. Tools, libraries
and code that the Freelancer owned before this Agreement remain the Freelancer's property, and the
Freelancer grants the Client a non-exclusive licence to use them as part of the deliverables.
5. Confidentiality
Each Party shall keep the other's non-public business and technical information confidential and use it only
for the Project. This duty continues for three years after this Agreement ends.
6. Data Protection
Each Party shall comply with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the Information Technology
Act, 2000 for any personal data handled in the Project. The Freelancer shall process such data only on the
Client's written instructions and shall maintain reasonable security safeguards.
7. Delay and Liquidated Damages
If the Freelancer delays final delivery beyond the agreed period, the Freelancer shall pay the Client liquidated
damages of Rs. 5,000 for every day of delay, without any maximum limit. The Parties agree that this amount
is a genuine pre-estimate of the Client's loss.
8. Liability and Indemnity
The Freelancer shall be liable for all losses suffered by the Client arising from this Agreement, including
indirect and consequential losses, and shall indemnify the Client against all third-party claims. The Client shall
have no liability to the Freelancer except to pay the fees due.
9. Non-Competition
For two years after this Agreement ends, the Freelancer shall not develop any e-commerce or shopping
application for any person or business anywhere in India.
10. Dispute Resolution
Any dispute arising from this Agreement shall be referred to arbitration under the Arbitration and Conciliation
Act, 1996 before a sole arbitrator appointed by the Client. The seat of arbitration shall be Pune and the
language shall be English.

clauses.reason: Uncapped daily liquidated damages constitute an unenforceable penalty under the law, as the continuous accumulation without a monetary ceiling can disproportionately exceed the total engagement value and does not reflect a reasonable pre-estimate of actual loss.
clauses.action: Introduce a reasonable aggregate liability cap on the liquidated damages and require prior written notice with an opportunity to remedy any delay before damages begin to accrue.
clauses.safer_clause: If the Law Firm fails to complete the agreed legal services by the scheduled delivery date due to its own unexcused default, and fails to remedy such delay within 7 days of receiving written notice from the Client, the Law Firm shall pay liquidated damages of Rs. 5,000 for each full day of unexcused delay; provided, however, that the total aggregate liquidated damages payable under this clause shall not exceed 10 percent of the total professional fees paid or payable under this Agreement, which the parties agree represents a fair, reasonable, and genuine pre-estimate of loss.

clauses.detected_issue: Unlimited unilateral liability including indirect/consequential damages and indemnity with zero client liability
clauses.negotiation_advice: Ask for a cap on liability, cover only proven losses from your own wilful misconduct or negligence, and make indemnity mutual.

similar_clauses.clause_text: The employee shall be liable for all losses, damages, costs, and expenses suffered by the company without any limitation.
The employee shall indemnify the company for any loss, whether direct or indirect, actual or remote, arising from employment.
The service provider shall be liable for all direct, indirect, incidental and consequential damages without any monetary limitation.

clauses.reason: The clause creates an entirely one-sided, unlimited liability framework that improperly includes indirect and consequential damages while disclaiming all liability for the Client, exposing the Law Firm to catastrophic financial risk beyond standard legal practice.
clauses.action: Exclude indirect and consequential damages for both parties, introduce a mutual indemnification framework, and institute a commercially reasonable liability cap linked to fees paid under the agreement.
clauses.safer_clause: Neither the Law Firm nor the Client shall be liable to the other for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising out of or in connection with this Agreement. The Law Firm shall indemnify and hold harmless the Client against direct losses arising from third-party claims resulting directly from the Law Firm's gross negligence or willful misconduct, and the Client shall indemnify the Law Firm against third-party claims arising out of instructions, information, or materials provided by the Client. The total aggregate liability of either party arising under or in connection with this Agreement, whether in contract, tort, or otherwise, shall be limited to the total fees paid or payable by the Client to the Law Firm under this Agreement.

clauses.action: Delete the blanket post-termination non-competition restriction and replace it with an enforceable covenant protecting proprietary confidential information and preventing the solicitation of the party's current clients.

## What this document is
This is a Service Agreement. The Freelancer will design, build, and test a shopping mobile app for Android and iOS for the Client. The total fee is **Rs. 1,20,000**, and court matters will be handled in Pune under Indian law.

## Who is involved
- The Freelancer
- The Client
- The Law Firm

## Important dates
- **1 October 2026**

## Money and payments
- **Rs. 1,20,000** total fee
- **Rs. 5,000**

## Main duties and rights
- Rules on how payments are made
- Rules on how to end the contract
- Rules on sending formal notices
- Rules to keep private information secret
- Rules on who pays for harm or losses
- Rules on solving legal disputes through an independent decider

## Risks to watch
- Unfair exit rules: The Client can cancel with **7 days'** notice, but the other side must give **60 days'** notice.
- Endless daily fines: Penalties for delays have no upper cap and can easily grow larger than the total project fee.
- One-sided responsibility for losses: You must pay for all indirect losses, while the Client takes zero legal blame.
- Trade ban for **2 years**: The contract tries to stop you from making shopping apps across India, which is against Indian law.
- Client chooses the judge: Letting only the Client pick the person who settles disputes is unfair and legally invalid.
- Long payment wait: The Client may take **60 days** to pay and does not have to pay interest on late money.

## Missing protections
- A legal dispute process, because letting one side pick the arbitrator is not permitted by law.
- A lawful competition clause, because completely stopping someone from working is void under Indian law.
- A fair limit on risk, because only one side carries all legal liability.
- Clear app testing rules, because there is no written process to review and accept the final work.
- Quality promises and bug fixes, because there is no written duty to fix errors after delivery.

- पैसे देण्यासंबंधीच्या अटींचा समावेश आहे.

- जबाबदारी संबंधीच्या नियमांचा समावेश आहे.

## काळजीपूर्वक पाहण्यासारखे धोके
- सेवा समाप्ती: क्लायंट फक्त **7 दिवसांची** नोटीस देऊन करार संपवू शकतो, पण दुसऱ्या पक्षाला **60 दिवसांची** नोटीस द्यावी लागेल.
- दंड: उशिराबद्दल लागणाऱ्या दैनंदिन दंडाच्या रकमेवर कोणतीही मर्यादा नाही, त्यामुळे हा दंड एकूण शुल्कापेक्षा खूप जास्त वाढू शकतो.
- जबाबदारी: क्लायंटवर कोणतीही जबाबदारी राहणार नाही, पण काम करणाऱ्या पक्षावर अमर्याद नुकसानभरपाईची जबाबदारी टाकली आहे.
- स्पर्धा न करण्याची अट: दोन वर्षांपर्यंत असे ॲप बनवण्यावर देशभरात बंदी घालणे कायद्यानुसार अवैध ठरू शकते.

- पैसे मिळणे: पेमेंटसाठी **60 दिवसांचा** मोठा कालावधी दिला आहे आणि पैसे उशिरा मिळाल्यास त्यावर कोणतेही व्याज मिळणार नाही.

## करारात नसलेल्या किंवा कमकुवत बाबी
- वाद निवारणाचे कलम कमकुवत आहे: केवळ क्लायंटने स्वतःचा लवाद नेमणे कायद्यानुसार अवैध आहे.
- स्पर्धा न करण्याची अट अयोग्य आहे: काम संपल्यानंतर काम करण्यावर बंदी घालणे भारतीय कायद्यानुसार अवैध मानले जाते.
- जबाबदारीची योग्य मर्यादा नाही: कलम 8 नुसार केवळ फ्रीलान्सरवर अमर्याद जबाबदारी टाकली आहे आणि क्लायंटला सर्व जबाबदारीतून मोकळे केले आहे.
- ॲप तपासणी आणि मंजुरीची पद्धत नाही: ॲपची तपासणी कशी होणार आणि किती दिवसांत मंजुरी मिळणार याचे स्पष्ट निकष नाहीत.
- वॉरंटी आणि त्रुटी सुधारणेची हमी नाही: कामाचा दर्जा, बौद्धिक संपदा अधिकार आणि ॲप दिल्यानंतर त्यातील दोष सुधारण्याबाबत कोणतीही स्पष्ट अट नाही.
translation.hindi:
## यह दस्तावेज क्या है
यह एक सेवा समझौता है। फ्रीलांसर एंड्रॉइड और आईओएस के लिए खरीदारी मोबाइल ऐप डिजाइन, बनाएगा और परीक्षण करेगा। कुल शुल्क 1,20,000 रुपये है, और भारतीय कानून के तहत पुणे में अदालत के मामलों का निपटारा किया जाएगा।

## इसमें कौन शामिल है
- फ्रीलांसर
- ग्राहक
- लॉ फर्म

## महत्वपूर्ण तिथियां
- 1 अक्टूबर 2026

## धन और भुगतान
- कुल शुल्क 1,20,000 रुपये
- 5,000 रुपये

## मुख्य कर्तव्य और अधिकार
- भुगतान के तरीके के बारे में नियम
- अनुबंध को समाप्त करने के नियम
- औपचारिक सूचनाओं के प्रेषण के नियम
- निजी जानकारी को गुप्त रखने के नियम
- नुकसान या हानि के लिए भुगतान करने वाले के बारे में नियम
- स्वतंत्र निर्णयकर्ता के माध्यम से कानूनी विवादों के समाधान के नियम

## देखने के लिए जोखिम
- अन्यायपूर्ण प्रस्थान नियमः ग्राहक 7 दिनों की सूचना के साथ रद्द कर सकता है, लेकिन दूसरी पक्ष को 60 दिनों की सूचना देनी होगी।
- अंतहीन दैनिक जुर्मानाः देरी के लिए जुर्माना की कोई ऊपरी सीमा नहीं होती है और यह आसानी से परियोजना शुल्क की कुल राशि से अधिक हो सकती है।
- नुकसान के लिए एकतरफा जिम्मेदारीः आपको सभी अप्रत्यक्ष नुकसान के लिए भुगतान करना होगा, जबकि ग्राहक शून्य कानूनी दोष लेता है।
- 2 साल के लिए व्यापार प्रतिबंधः अनुबंध आपको पूरे भारत में शॉपिंग ऐप बनाने से रोकने की कोशिश करता है, जो भारतीय कानून के खिलाफ है।
- ग्राहक न्यायाधीश का चुनाव करता हैः केवल ग्राहक को विवादों को सुलझाने वाले व्यक्ति का चयन करने देना अनुचित और कानूनी रूप से अमान्य है।
- भुगतान का लंबा इंतजारः भुगतान करने में ग्राहक को 60 दिन लग सकते हैं और देर से भुगतान पर ब्याज नहीं देना पड़ता है।

## रक्षा का अभाव
- एक कानूनी विवाद प्रक्रिया, क्योंकि एक पक्ष को मध्यस्थ चुनने की अनुमति कानून द्वारा अनुमति नहीं है।
- एक कानूनी प्रतिस्पर्धा खंड, क्योंकि किसी को काम करने से पूरी तरह से रोकना भारतीय कानून के तहत अमान्य है।
- जोखिम की उचित सीमा, क्योंकि केवल एक पक्ष ही पूरी कानूनी जिम्मेदारी लेता है।
- एप टेस्टिंग के नियम स्पष्ट करें, क्योंकि अंतिम कार्य की समीक्षा और स्वीकृति के लिए कोई लिखित प्रक्रिया नहीं है।
- गुणवत्ता के वादे और बग फिक्स, क्योंकि डिलीवरी के बाद त्रुटियों को ठीक करने का कोई लिखित दायित्व नहीं है।
